mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ select rpi.prod_id prodId, case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||'（'||rpi.prod_id||'）' else rpi.prod_name end titleName, case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||rpi.prod_name else rpi.prod_name end prodName, nvl(rpi2.prod_re,rpi.prod_re) regCode, rpi.SET_DATE setDate, nvl(rpi2.prod_id,rpi.prod_id) pprodId from rep_prod_info rpi left join rep_prod_info rpi2 on rpi.p_prod_id = rpi2.prod_id and rpi2.status = 'E' where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId} and rpi.status = 'E'

SELECT PINDEX.ASSETS_VALUE /**资产净值**/ ,PINDEX.CAPITAL /**期末余额**/ ,PINDEX.UNIT_VALUE /**单位净值**/ ,PLAN.SETT_DATE /**本期收益结算日**/ ,PLAN.PAYMENT_DATE /*红利发放日*/ ,PLAN.ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS /**业绩基准**/ ,PLAN.ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS_PROP /**业绩基准比例**/ ,PLAN.EXCESS_ACHIEVEMENT_PROP /**超额收益收取比例**/ ,DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE /*开放起始日*/ ,DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE /*开放结束日*/ FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON PINDEX.PROD_ID=NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' AND PINDEX.VALUE_DATE=TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN PLAN ON PLAN.PROD_ID=NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND PLAN.DATA_STATUS='E' AND PLAN.SETT_DATE=TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE=TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') WHERE INFO.STATUS='E' AND INFO.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE,DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO,DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP WHERE INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE>TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT PINDEX.UNIT_VALUE_T as unitValue, DPB.SETT_DATE settDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO,REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX,DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN DPB WHERE INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND PINDEX.STATUS = 'E' AND DPB.DATA_STATUS = 'E' AND PINDEX.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPB.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PINDEX.VALUE_DATE = DPB.SETT_DATE AND DPB.SETT_DATE = ( select SETT_DATE from ( select h.SETT_DATE from DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN h where h.SETT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and h.DATA_STATUS = 'E' order by h.busi_date ) where rownum = 1 )
